feature: Captions: safe-area guides, the Auto badge and the Caption track bar
summary: With captions on a recording and the timeline open, title-safe and action-safe guides and an AUTO · EN badge sit over the picture, a Caption track bar over the timeline reads the word being said and the time with Clear and Reset, and picking the captions opens the panel on the Captions options.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a recording with speech and let its captions write themselves.

try.do: Open the timeline (click the TIMELINE row under the transport, or press Option-Command-T).
Scrub the playhead across the Words lane and watch Active word and the time in the Caption track bar.
Click the caption words on the picture to pick the Captions layer.
Click Safe areas in the Captions section's Guides row to hide the guides, then again to bring them back.
Pick the Karaoke style and drag the captions to the top of the picture.
Click Reset in the Caption track bar.
Right-click the Captions track header: Safe Areas and Reset Captions are there too.

evaluate: Should the guides and the badge stay hidden while a recording is open only to watch (timeline tucked), as they are now?
Is Reset putting the look and the place back, while leaving the words alone, what you expect Reset to do?
Does the Caption track bar belong at the top of the timeline, over the ruler, or would you rather it sat directly above the Captions track row?
Are the guide labels (8 pt, as the mock draws them) readable enough at your usual zoom?
rough: The mock calls the section 'Title / Text tool options'; here it stays the Captions section, with the app's Auto switch between Guides and Generate.
The mock's Reset says 'Reset this demo'. In the app it puts the Captions layer back in the standard look and the box a fresh one lands in, as one undo step.
The bar sits over the ruler rather than inside the track list, because a playhead line ran through its words when it sat directly above the Captions track.
The badge names the language set in the Captions section now, not the one the captions were first written in.
The Generate button still reads 'Write Ag...' at this panel width; that is owned by another open task.
